name: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT) Seared Flank Steak & Jasmine Rice Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Zao Asian Cafe (Draper & South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Tender wok-seared flank steak slices served over fluffy white jasmine rice with steamed carrots. Mild teriyaki glaze adds flavor without chili heat or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Select white jasmine rice base, seared steak, steamed carrots, and mild teriyaki sauce (hold raw cabbage slaw, jalapeños, and chili paste).
watchOuts: Avoid raw cabbage slaw and spicy chili sambal sauces
